import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { searchSongs, Song } from '../services/youtubeService';

export const MusicApp: React.FC = () => {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [songs, setSongs] = useState<Song[]>([]);
  const [currentSong, setCurrentSong] = useState<Song | null>(null);
  const [isPlaying, setIsPlaying] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Cargar canciones iniciales al abrir la app
    searchSongs('').then(data => {
      setSongs(data);
      if (data.length > 0) setCurrentSong(data[0]);
    });
  }, []);

  const handleSearch = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const results = await searchSongs(query);
    setSongs(results);
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-screen bg-gray-950 text-white font-sans">
      {/* Header / Buscador */}
      <header className="p-4 bg-gray-900 border-b border-gray-800 flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <h1 className="text-xl font-bold tracking-wider text-pink-500">🎧 Figma Music Stream</h1>
        <form onSubmit={handleSearch} className="flex w-full md:w-96 gap-2">
          <input
            type="text"
            placeholder="Buscar canción, artista o beat..."
            value={query}
            onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full px-4 py-2 bg-gray-800 rounded-lg border border-gray-700 focus:outline-none focus:border-pink-500 text-sm"
          />
          <button
            type="submit"
            className="px-4 py-2 bg-pink-600 hover:bg-pink-500 text-white rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold transition"
          >
            Buscar
          </button>
        </form>
      </header>

      {/* Contenido Principal: Lista de canciones */}
      <main className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 md:p-6 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        {songs.map((song) => (
          <div
            key={song.id}
            onClick={() => {
              setCurrentSong(song);
              setIsPlaying(true);
            }}
            className={`flex items-center gap-4 p-3 rounded-xl cursor-pointer transition border ${
              currentSong?.id === song.id
                ? 'bg-pink-950/40 border-pink-500'
                : 'bg-gray-900/60 border-gray-800 hover:bg-gray-800'
            }`}
          >
            <img src={song.thumbnail} alt={song.title} className="w-16 h-16 object-cover rounded-lg" />
            <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
              <h3 className="font-semibold text-sm truncate">{song.title}</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 truncate">{song.artist}</p>
            </div>
            <button className="p-2 text-pink-400 hover:text-white">
              ▶️
            </button>
          </div>
        ))}
      </main>

      {/* Barra Reproductor inferior */}
      {currentSong && (
        <footer className="p-4 bg-gray-900 border-t border-gray-800 flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4 shadow-2xl">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 w-full md:w-auto">
            <img src={currentSong.thumbnail} alt="" className="w-12 h-12 rounded object-cover" />
            <div className="truncate">
              <p className="text-sm font-medium truncate">{currentSong.title}</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 truncate">{currentSong.artist}</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Reproductor Iframe integrado oculto/funcional de YouTube */}
          <div className="w-full md:w-auto flex flex-col items-center gap-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
              <button 
                onClick={() => setIsPlaying(!isPlaying)}
                className="w-10 h-10 bg-pink-600 hover:bg-pink-500 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-white transition"
              >
                {isPlaying ? '⏸' : '▶'}
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className="w-full hidden md:block">
              <iframe
                title="YouTube Audio Player"
                width="200"
                height="40"
                src={`https://www.youtube.com/embed/${currentSong.id}?autoplay=${isPlaying ? 1 : 0}&enablejsapi=1`}
                className="rounded opacity-80 hover:opacity-100 transition"
                allow="autoplay"
              ></iframe>
            </div>
          </div>
        </footer>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};
